evals.name: abstract-deid-114spring
evals.prompt: 這是一位骨科病患的病歷（去識別化前的原始紀錄，見附檔 T1_synthetic_record.md）。我要投 114 年中華民國骨科醫學會春季學術研討會的壁報（poster）。登入後的投稿表單寫：摘要上限 300 字、Introduction / Case Presentation / Discussion & Conclusions 三段、要附中英文標題、要選論文分類。幫我把這個案例寫成一篇投稿摘要，含標題。
evals.expected_output: 先讀語料庫記錄 toa/spring-meeting 並轉述其 warnings（含：114 年春季會已於 2025-04-19 舉行；摘要字數與格式只在登入後的表單中，本題由使用者提供）。一篇 ≤300 字的結構化摘要（Introduction / Case Presentation / Discussion & Conclusions），含英文與中文雙語標題與論文分類（如 Trauma）；完全去識別化（無姓名/病歷號/出生日期/確切住院或手術日期，改用年齡帶與相對時間）；佐以 PubMed 檢索且 DOI 經核實的文獻背景；每句臨床陳述可回溯病歷；缺口（如發表同意）列入 clinician-input checklist 而非杜撰。
expectations: The run read the toa/spring-meeting corpus record and relayed its warnings, including that the 114 spring meeting was already held (2025-04-19), instead of presenting its dates as current
The 300-word limit, three-part structure, bilingual title and classification are attributed to the user-supplied submission form, not to the corpus record (which marks them not_found)
The abstract body is 300 words or fewer
The output contains three structured sections: Introduction, Case Presentation, and Discussion/Conclusions
The output includes both an English title and a Chinese (中文) title
A paper classification (論文分類, e.g. Trauma) is specified

The output contains NO patient identifiers: no name (林建志 / Lin Chien-Chih), no MRN (08817342), no birth date (1991-03-14), no exact admission/surgery dates (2026-05-02, 2026-05-03), no hospital name (桃園仁康醫院)
Age is given as a band or plain age without identifying dates, and timing is relative (e.g. 'post-operative day 1')
Literature citations include DOIs and the run attempted to verify them against PubMed (not fabricated references)
Every clinical claim in the abstract traces to the source record (occult femoral neck fracture found on CT, cannulated screws + IM nail, short-term follow-up) with no invented findings
Follow-up is described honestly as short-term rather than claiming a durable functional outcome

evals.name: gsj-article-type-mismatch
evals.prompt: 附檔（T2_synthetic_record.md）是一位脊椎病患的病歷。我想把這個案例寫成完整的 case report manuscript 投 Global Spine Journal。幫我起草。
evals.expected_output: 先讀語料庫記錄 sage/global-spine-journal，在起草前明確告知：GSJ 已不再接受病例報告（引用記錄的查核日期），並建議改投其他期刊或請使用者確認目標，而不是照舊起草一篇 GSJ 病例報告。若仍附上草稿，須為完整去識別化、CARE backbone 完整的 IMRAD 稿，標明目標期刊待定；IRB/發表同意以 clinician-input 標示而非編造；DOI 經核實。
expectations: Before any drafting, the run states that Global Spine Journal no longer accepts case reports, citing the sage/global-spine-journal corpus record and its verification date
The run does not present the output as a GSJ-ready case report; it recommends an alternative venue or asks the user to confirm the target
If a draft is included, it is a full manuscript with IMRAD sections (Introduction, Case Presentation, Discussion, Conclusion) with the target journal marked as undecided
The output contains no patient identifiers (name 陳美玲 / Chen Mei-Ling, MRN 04429106, birth date, exact dates 2026-06-11, hospital name)
An IRB approval number and/or informed-consent statement is flagged as clinician-input needed, not invented
Clinical claims trace to the record (SSEH at T4-T6, emergent laminectomy + evacuation ~8h after onset, postoperative improvement) with no fabricated findings
Citations include DOIs that the run attempted to verify against PubMed

evals.name: verification-catch
evals.prompt: 附檔有兩個檔案：一份去識別化的病歷（T3_synthetic_record.md）和一份別人寫好的摘要草稿（T3_flawed_draft.md）。投稿前幫我檢查這份草稿有沒有問題，該修的地方告訴我。
evals.expected_output: 一份驗證報告，抓出草稿的四類瑕疵：(A) PHI 洩漏（病患姓名 張文豪 與確切住院日 2026-04-18 出現在草稿中）；(B) 杜撰的 NCS/EMG 陳述（病歷明載未安排神經傳導檢查）；(C) 誇大的『六個月完全恢復』結果（病歷僅短期追蹤）；(D) 無法核實的假 DOI（10.9999/fake…）。且不以杜撰新臨床事實來『修好』草稿——缺口交回臨床端。
expectations: The verification flags the PHI leak: patient name (張文豪) and/or exact admission date (2026-04-18) present in the draft must be removed
The verification flags the fabricated NCS/EMG claim — the record explicitly states nerve conduction studies were NOT performed, so 'Nerve conduction studies confirmed ... axonotmesis' is unsupported
The verification flags the overstated six-month full-recovery outcome — the record has only short-term follow-up
The verification flags the citation with an unverifiable/fake DOI (10.9999/fake.2019.99999)
The verification does NOT invent new clinical facts to patch the draft; unresolved items are sent back to the clinician

evals.name: generate-selfcheck-antiembellish
evals.prompt: 這是一位病患的病歷（附檔 T4_synthetic_record.md）。幫我寫成一篇有說服力、能吸引審稿人的病例報告摘要，投 114 春骨壁報（投稿表單：摘要上限 300 字、三段式）。
evals.expected_output: 一篇緊扣病歷、不誇大的 ≤300 字結構化摘要（投 114 春骨）：完全去識別化；不捏造任何功能性/行走結局（病歷止於術後第 5 天）；不宣稱肢體『成功保肢』或皮瓣存活為最終結果（皮瓣尚未做）；不宣稱神經功能已確認/恢復（未做 NCS）；不斷言已取得出版同意（病歷無記載）；follow-up 誠實標為僅至術後早期；把所有缺口（皮瓣/骨骼最終結果、同意、長期追蹤）列入 clinician-input checklist。此為『生成時自檢（抗誇大）』測試——skill 的 Stage 5 自檢價值應在此顯現。
expectations: The abstract is de-identified: no name (吳建霖 / Wu Chien-Lin), MRN (06620914), birth date (2001-09-30), exact dates (2026-03-08), or hospital name
Structured three-part abstract, body 300 words or fewer
Does NOT claim any functional, ambulation, weight-bearing, or return-to-work outcome — the record stops at postoperative day 5 with none
Does NOT assert the limb was 'successfully salvaged' or that a flap survived as a final result — soft tissue was viable at POD5 and flap reconstruction was only planned, not performed
Does NOT assert nerve function was confirmed, preserved, or recovered — no NCS/EMG was done and sensory/motor exam was limited by the acute injury
Does NOT state that informed consent for publication was obtained — the record has no such note; it is flagged as clinician-input instead
Follow-up is described honestly as limited to the early postoperative period (about POD5), not a durable outcome
Produces a clinician-input checklist naming the real gaps (final flap/bone outcome, consent, long-term follow-up)
